summary: Album cover choice tested (backend pytest + Playwright desktop 1920 & mobile 390). Set cover works: toast 'Album borítókép beállítva.', data-cover=true only on the chosen photo, 'Album borítókép' label shown, home card gallery-album-karacsony-2026 img src = chosen photo, Farsang album unaffected (falls back to its first photo), switching cover inside the album clears the old one (one cover per album, case-insensitive/trimmed grouping checked), lightbox opens on the cover (counter 3 / 3, image = cover). Unauthenticated -> 401, unknown id -> 404, GET /api/gallery returns is_cover. Star is hidden until hover on desktop and always visible at 390px (36x36). FAILED: editing the cover photo's caption does NOT reset is_cover (still true via API and data-cover=true in the UI). All 5 UI photos and all pytest photos were deleted; gallery is empty ([]).

critical.issue: Changing caption_hu/caption_ro does not set is_cover=false. update_gallery_photo only $sets the changed fields. The moved photo stays is_cover=true and becomes the cover of its new album without anyone choosing it. If the target album already has a cover, it ends up with two covers.

integration_issues.issue: After saving the new caption, gallery-set-cover-<id> still has data-cover=true and shows the 'Album borítókép' label (caused by the backend bug)

design_issues.screen: Lightbox with very small images (40x50 test PNGs)
issues: Counter, caption and institution pills get squeezed into narrow vertical stacks over the small image. Low priority; real photos are larger, but consider giving the image container a min-width.

action_items: In update_gallery_photo (backend/routers/admin_ext.py): if caption_hu or caption_ro is in changes and the album key changes (or always on caption change, as the spec says), add is_cover: False to the $set
critical_code_review_comments: set_album_cover loads every is_cover photo (to_list(5000)) and filters in Python. That is fine at this scale; a case-insensitive regex or a stored normalized album_key field would scale better.
set_album_cover is not atomic: two concurrent requests could leave two covers. Low risk for an admin-only action.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all cover flows pass except caption-edit reset)

seed_data_creation: None kept. All created photos were deleted and GET /api/gallery returns [].
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest tests/test_gallery_album_cover.py (it cleans up after itself). The failing test is test_caption_edit_resets_cover. Admin tab: admin-tab-gallery. The upload institution select is a native <select> (use select_option).
